description:
The modern design of the Strider Pro 2-in-1 Rocking Bike is a smart alternative to the traditional rocking horse and offers two incredible toys in one. Babies everywhere are clapping their chubby little hands now that they too can ride - or play - on a bike.
It's never too early to spark a love of riding. Babies bond with their first bike and begin the learn-to-ride process before they even start walking.
First, help baby get comfortable sitting in the saddle and holding the handlebar. Then, watch them light up when they quickly discover how to get rocking all on their own!
Eventually, your kiddo will be rocking so hard you'll think they're about to blast off into the stratosphere. Don't worry, we disengaged the rocket engines. This baby's (no pun intended) all self-propelled.
When they're ready to roll, simply remove the Strider 12 Pro Balance Bike from the Rocking Base - all without touching a toolkit. The Strider 12 Pro Balance Bike grows with your kiddo up to 4 years old (inseam measurement of 26-46 cm. / 10-18 in.).
We believe a baby who rocks becomes a toddler who rides. With the Strider Pro 2-in-1 Rocking Bike, your kiddo is already training to become a two-wheeling legend!
